recipes.name: Clarified Browned Buttermilk
recipes.instructions: Brown butter over medium heat until deeply golden and nutty. Lower heat; add milk powder and whisk 30–60 sec until toasted. Slowly whisk in milk. Gently simmer 2–3 min without a hard boil. Immersion blend 1–2 min. Cool to 65–75°F / 18–24°C. Fine with your established Kieselsol → Chitosan → Kieselsol process, then run through the Spinzall. Exact fining dosage is not specified here.

recipes.name: Tomato Water
recipes.instructions: Canonical production ratio: cucumber = 8% of tomato weight; fennel = 2.5%; kosher salt = 1%. Clarification enzyme/fining quantities are intentionally not hard-coded here because the supplied canonical ratio did not specify them.

recipes.name: Saturday Morning Cartoons
recipes.instructions: Combine all punch ingredients except milk. Warm whole milk to 120–130°F / 50–55°C. Slowly pour punch into milk and gently stir once. Allow coagulation for 30 min. Run through Spinzall; recirculate/second spin if needed. Polish through a coffee filter. No post-clarification saline or vanilla.

recipes.name: Earl Grey Concentrate
recipes.instructions: Heat water to 195°F / 91°C. Steep exactly 4 minutes. Strain without squeezing and chill rapidly.

recipes.name: Fruity Pebbles Syrup
recipes.instructions: Combine water and sugar; heat to 160–170°F until dissolved. Remove from heat and add cereal. Hold around 150–160°F for 15 min. Strain without pressing cereal. Fine-filter, add salt, chill, and refrigerate.

recipes.name: Pandan Coconut Foam

recipes.name: Oolong Old Fashioned
